title: Investment Property
intro: العقار الاستثماري: عقار مُحتفظ به لـ **الإيجار** أو لـ **زيادة قيمته**، مش للاستخدام ولا للبيع العادي.
تختار **نموذج القيمة العادلة** (التغيرات في الأرباح والخسائر وبدون إهلاك) أو **نموذج التكلفة** لكل العقارات الاستثمارية.

tf.s: Land held for an undetermined future use is investment property.
tf.why: It is treated as held for capital appreciation.

tf.s: Under the fair value model, fair value gains are recognised in OCI.
tf.why: They are recognised in profit or loss.

tf.s: Property held for sale in the ordinary course of business is inventory under IAS 2.
Investment property is initially measured at cost, including transaction costs.
tf.why: E.g. legal fees and property transfer taxes.

tf.s: An entity using the cost model for investment property must disclose its fair value.
tf.why: Fair value disclosure is still required.

tf.s: Investment property under the fair value model is depreciated.
tf.why: No depreciation under the fair value model.

fill.s: Under the fair value model, changes in fair value go to ___.
Investment property is held to earn rentals or for capital ___.
Owner-occupied property is accounted for under IAS ___.
The chosen model must be applied to ___ investment property.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: Investment property under the fair value model rises from 2,000,000 to 2,300,000.
je.why: IAS 40 fair value changes go to profit or loss.

je.s: Rent of 60,000 for the current year is received in cash.
je.why: Rent earned in the year is income.

calc.why: Transaction costs are included in initial cost.
